floor-closet.note: The Closet's floor: pale maple boards (block 0, 11), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. Lighter than the Bedroom's honey planks, so a closet off a bedroom reads as its own room (D-093).

floor-mudroom.note: The Mudroom's floor: grey slate tiles with light grout (block 2, 13), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. A hard-wearing entry floor, unlike the Bathroom's blue tiles.

floor-playroom.note: The Playroom's floor: lavender tiles like a foam play mat (block 2, 8), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. No other room has a purple floor, so it isn't mistaken for the Living Room.

face-bedroom.note: The north wall face of a bedroom (teal and sand diamonds on lilac): the wall block at [0, 0]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.

face-bathroom.note: The north wall face of a bathroom (mint green with a white stripe): the wall block at [352, 448]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask. Its green sets it off from the Bathroom's pale blue tiles, which the white tiles it replaces matched (playtest 5a's face audit).

face-kitchen.note: The north wall face of a kitchen (cream with a butter-yellow stripe): the wall block at [0, 288]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.

The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.

face-living-room.note: The north wall face of a living room (warm sand): the wall block at [0, 352]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.

face-closet.note: The north wall face of a closet (white panels): the wall block at [0, 32]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask. Whiter than the Closet's pale maple floor, which the grey beige it replaces nearly matched (playtest 5a's face audit).

face-hallway.note: The north wall face of a hallway (plain cream): the wall block at [0, 96]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.

face-library.note: The north wall face of a library (pale olive): the wall block at [0, 192]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. Light, so the wall reads against the Library's red-brown floor and against a dark floor beyond the band; the red-brown panelling it replaces was the floor's own color (playtest 5a).

bed-double-0.note: A Bedroom's double bed with a pale blue duvet, headboard against the north wall. Bedrooms take the duvets in turn, so two never look copy-pasted.

bed-double-1.note: A Bedroom's double bed with a lime and yellow striped duvet, headboard against the north wall. Bedrooms take the duvets in turn, so two never look copy-pasted.

bed-double-2.note: A Bedroom's double bed with a blue striped duvet, headboard against the north wall. Bedrooms take the duvets in turn, so two never look copy-pasted.

bed-double-3.note: A Bedroom's double bed with a green striped duvet, headboard against the north wall. Bedrooms take the duvets in turn, so two never look copy-pasted.

nightstand-0.note: A nightstand in honey wood, either side of a Bedroom's bed when the north wall has room.

nightstand-1.note: A nightstand in cherry wood, either side of a Bedroom's bed when the north wall has room.

nightstand-2.note: A nightstand in pale ash wood, either side of a Bedroom's bed when the north wall has room.

rug-round-0.note: A round pink rug, drawn under a Bedroom's bed.

rug-round-1.note: A round brown rug, the other Bedroom rug.

bunk-bed-0.note: Bunk Beds (fixture), blue bedding, with a ladder: they replace the Bedroom's double bed, so a room that counts twice reads as one at a glance.

bunk-bed-1.note: Bunk Beds (fixture), green bedding, with a ladder: they replace the Bedroom's double bed, so a room that counts twice reads as one at a glance.

bunk-bed-2.note: Bunk Beds (fixture), lilac bedding, with a ladder: they replace the Bedroom's double bed, so a room that counts twice reads as one at a glance.

toilet-0.note: A Bathroom's toilet with a wooden seat, tank against the north wall. Spliced to 26 px tall (the tank, then the seat ring and bowl: the raised lid's rows are left out), so in a one-cell Bathroom it rises over the wall band but not past it.

toilet-1.note: A Bathroom's toilet with a white seat, tank against the north wall. Spliced to 26 px tall (the tank, then the seat ring and bowl: the raised lid's rows are left out), so in a one-cell Bathroom it rises over the wall band but not past it.

toilet-2.note: A Bathroom's toilet with a beige seat, tank against the north wall. Spliced to 26 px tall (the tank, then the seat ring and bowl: the raised lid's rows are left out), so in a one-cell Bathroom it rises over the wall band but not past it.

bath-mat.note: A striped bath mat, on a Bathroom's floor when it fits.

fridge.note: A white fridge, at the end of a kitchen counter run.

range.note: A range with four burners and an oven: every kitchen's key item.

counter-sink.note: A 32 px kitchen counter with a sink: the white counter top over the cabinet strip (its two outlined ends and a pair of doors), with the sink and its tap on top.

counter.note: A 16 px kitchen counter: the counter top over the cabinet strip, cut down to its two outlined ends. It fills a run between the range and the fridge.

kitchen-island.note: Kitchen Island (fixture): a free-standing counter in the middle of the Kitchen, its top over a row of cabinet doors, with a bowl of fruit on it so it reads at a glance.

kitchen-island-24.note: Kitchen Island (fixture), 24 px: the island with one cabinet door, for a kitchen where the full one won't fit (an L-Kitchen's corner, beside a door's walkway). Its bowl of fruit still reads at a glance.

kitchen-island-16.note: Kitchen Island (fixture), 16 px: a one-cabinet island with its bowl of fruit, for the narrow arm of an L-Kitchen.

dining-table-0.note: A Dining Room's table in pale oak, long side north to south.

dining-table-1.note: A Dining Room's table in cherry, long side north to south.

dining-table-2.note: A Dining Room's table in honey, long side north to south.

chair-east-0.note: A dining chair in pale wood, facing east: it stands west of the pale table (dining-table-0).

chair-west-0.note: A dining chair in pale wood, facing west: it stands east of the pale table (dining-table-0).

chair-east-1.note: A dining chair in cherry wood, facing east: it stands west of the cherry table (dining-table-1).

chair-west-1.note: A dining chair in cherry wood, facing west: it stands east of the cherry table (dining-table-1).

chair-east-2.note: A dining chair in honey wood, facing east: it stands west of the honey table (dining-table-2).

chair-west-2.note: A dining chair in honey wood, facing west: it stands east of the honey table (dining-table-2).

breakfast-table.note: A kitchen's breakfast table: a small honey-wood table between two honey-wood chairs, one cut so it's placed as one piece where the floor is free.

mat-square-0.note: A square mat with a brown border, under a table or an armchair.

mat-square-1.note: A square mat with an olive border.

mat-square-2.note: A square mat with a wine border.

sofa-0.note: A three-seat slate blue sofa, facing south: a Living Room's key item. Living Rooms take the colors in turn. Cut to its own 27 rows (the two below are the next sprite's outline).

sofa-1.note: A three-seat light grey sofa, facing south: a Living Room's key item. Living Rooms take the colors in turn. Cut to its own 27 rows (the two below are the next sprite's outline).

sofa-2.note: A three-seat tan sofa, facing south: LimeZu's modular tan sofa put together, its two-seat piece's left end, the loose middle seat, then the two-seat piece's right end, so it has both ends and its legs (the sheet's own row has no right end).

sofa-3.note: A three-seat lavender sofa, facing south: LimeZu's modular lavender sofa put together like the tan one, with both ends and its legs.

plant-potted.note: A potted plant: Living Rooms, Hallways, Bedrooms and the Sunroom put them in corners.

rug-wide-0.note: A wide red and gold rug, under a landscape Living Room's coffee table.

rug-wide-1.note: A wide blue and gold rug.

rug-tall-0.note: A tall blue and gold rug, for a portrait Living Room (sprites never turn, so the rug has its own upright cut).

rug-tall-1.note: A tall red and gold rug.

coffee-table.note: A low wooden coffee table, in front of the sofa.

fireplace.note: Fireplace (fixture): a stove with its flue going up the north wall, its flame flickering over three frames.

clothes-rail.note: A garment rail of hanging clothes: a Closet's key item.

shoes-0.note: A pair of brown shoes on the floor of a Closet or a Mudroom.

shoes-1.note: A pair of green shoes on the floor of a Closet or a Mudroom.

shoes-2.note: A pair of blue shoes on the floor of a Closet or a Mudroom.

coat-rack.note: A standing coat rack, in a Mudroom or a hall.

bench.note: A wooden bench, for taking boots off in a Mudroom.

washer.note: A washing machine: a Mudroom's key item. Three rows of its plain white top taken out (26 px, not 29), so it stands against the north wall of a one-cell-deep Mudroom too.

runner-h-0.note: A hall runner's west end (the short mat's left half), two of its middle rows left out so it's 12 px deep: it fits a hall between two outside walls.

runner-h-1.note: A hall runner's middle, repeated between its ends, two of its middle rows left out so it's 12 px deep: it fits a hall between two outside walls.

runner-h-2.note: A hall runner's east end (the short mat's right half), two of its middle rows left out so it's 12 px deep: it fits a hall between two outside walls.

runner-v-0.note: An upright hall runner's north end: the square mat's outer columns side by side, 14 px wide (rugs don't turn, so upright halls get their own).

runner-v-1.note: An upright hall runner's middle, repeated between its ends: the square mat's outer columns side by side, 14 px wide (rugs don't turn, so upright halls get their own).

runner-v-2.note: An upright hall runner's south end: the square mat's outer columns side by side, 14 px wide (rugs don't turn, so upright halls get their own).

car-rear-0.note: A blue car seen from behind, parked nose-in through a south garage door.

car-front-0.note: A blue car seen from the front, parked nose-in through a north garage door.

car-rear-1.note: A red car seen from behind, parked nose-in through a south garage door.

car-front-1.note: A red car seen from the front, parked nose-in through a north garage door.

car-right-0.note: A blue car from the side, facing east: parked nose-in through a west garage door.

car-left-0.note: The blue car facing west (mirrored): parked nose-in through an east garage door.

car-right-1.note: A red car from the side, facing east: parked nose-in through a west garage door.

car-left-1.note: The red car facing west (mirrored): parked nose-in through an east garage door.

boxes.note: A stack of cardboard boxes against a Garage's north wall.

desk-pc.note: A desk with a computer: a Home Office's key item.

desk-study.note: A low desk with an open book and a pencil cup, for a Home Office too shallow for the computer desk.

desk-small.note: A small writing desk with papers and a book, for a Home Office too narrow for the other desks.

plant-small.note: A small potted plant, where a big one won't fit.

pot-flowers-0.note: A clay pot of yellow flowers, in a Sunroom's corners.

pot-flowers-1.note: A clay pot of pink flowers, in a Sunroom's corners.

pot-flowers-2.note: A clay pot of white flowers, in a Sunroom's corners.

bookcase-0.note: A cherry bookcase full of books.

bookcase-1.note: A honey bookcase full of books.

bookcase-2.note: A pale bookcase full of books.

bookcase-narrow.note: A narrow bookcase full of books, for a Library whose Fireplace takes most of its north wall.

globe.note: A globe on a stand, beside a bookcase.

armchair-0.note: A sky blue armchair, facing south: Libraries and Sunrooms.

armchair-1.note: A cream armchair, facing south: Libraries and Sunrooms.

armchair-2.note: A red armchair, facing south: Libraries and Sunrooms.

armchair-3.note: A pale blue armchair, facing south: Libraries and Sunrooms.

toy-box.note: A toy chest (the animated toy box's first frame), against a Playroom's north wall.

teddy-0.note: A teddy bear sitting on a Playroom's floor.

teddy-1.note: A teddy bear with a green scarf.

toy-train.note: A toy train of three cars on the Playroom floor.

plant-tall.note: A big leafy potted plant: a Sunroom's key item.
